help.sections.start.title: Getting Started
help.sections.start.intro: BeyLink is a "link-in-bio" page where you can gather all your links in a single place. The basic workflow is very simple.
help.sections.start.items.0.label: 1. Create your profile
help.sections.start.items.0.text: When you sign up, a public page is automatically created at `beylink.org/username`. You can use either your email or username to log in.
help.sections.start.items.1.label: 2. Add blocks
help.sections.start.items.1.text: From the "Links" tab, add blocks such as links, social media, contact cards, and galleries to your page.
help.sections.start.items.2.label: 3. Design
help.sections.start.items.2.text: From the "Design" tab, customize your theme, colors, cover image, and layout. See a live preview on the phone on the right.

faq.0.question: What is BeyLink?
faq.0.answer: BeyLink is a link-in-bio platform that gathers all your links behind a single link in your social media bio. Your page lives at beylink.org/username.
faq.1.question: Can I use it for free?
faq.1.answer: Yes. Our Free plan lets you add unlimited links, build your profile with the basic themes, and use your QR code. Paid plans add advanced analytics, SEO, sub-accounts, and professional templates.
faq.2.question: How fast can I build my page?
faq.2.answer: About 5 minutes from sign-up to going live. Once your email is verified, just customize your profile and flip the publish toggle on.
faq.3.question: Can I change my username later?
faq.3.answer: No. Your username (your page address) is set the moment you register and it's permanent, so it's worth choosing carefully before you sign up.
faq.4.question: Can I move links or profiles between two accounts?
faq.4.answer: You can create a sub-account under the same main account and move things over. Moving between separate main accounts is manual, so just reach out to support.
faq.5.question: What kinds of links can I add?
faq.5.answer: Web links, social media, email (mailto), phone (tel), contact cards (vCard), photo galleries, and divider blocks. Menu, crypto, and location blocks are on the way.
faq.6.question: Is BeyLink good for Instagram and TikTok bios?
faq.6.answer: Absolutely. That's exactly what it's built for. Drop a single link in your Instagram or TikTok bio and let people reach all your platforms from there.
faq.7.question: How does the analytics feature work?
faq.7.answer: Every click and view is recorded, with daily, weekly, and monthly charts plus breakdowns by unique visitor, device, browser, country, and referrer. Anti-fraud dedup keeps the same visitor from being counted twice on the same day.
faq.8.question: How do I use the QR code?
faq.8.answer: Once your page is published, download it as a high-resolution PNG from your dashboard. Use it anywhere: business cards, posters, menus, storefronts.
faq.9.question: Do you support SEO?
faq.9.answer: On Basic and up, you can edit your meta title and description, Open Graph, Facebook Pixel, and advanced SEO fields. Server-side OG rendering (SSR) for crawlers and JSON-LD (ProfilePage → Person) are generated automatically.
faq.10.question: Can I connect my own domain?
faq.10.answer: Custom domains (one per user) are on our roadmap. For now, every profile is published under beylink.org/username.
faq.11.question: What are sub-accounts for?
faq.11.answer: You can create separate profiles for your team members, clients, or sub-brands. They only see their own profile, while you manage them all from a single panel. Pro includes 3 sub-accounts and Pro Plus 15, and with add-on packs you can go up to 40.
faq.12.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.12.answer: Right now, USDT (TRC-20) crypto payments. You top up your balance, then buy plans and add-on packs from it. Stripe/iyzico integration is coming soon.
faq.13.question: Can I downgrade my plan?
faq.13.answer: Plans are upgrade-only. But when your upgraded plan expires, the remaining time from your previous plan kicks back in automatically, so you never lose a single day.
faq.14.question: Are the templates ready to use, or do I start from scratch?
faq.14.answer: You get 10 content templates (business card, musician, restaurant, photographer, freelancer, and more) pre-filled. Just swap the placeholders, save, and publish. There are also 8 free and 10 professional themes to choose from.
faq.15.question: Is there two-factor authentication?
faq.15.answer: Yes. There's TOTP-based 2FA, compatible with Google Authenticator, Authy, and Microsoft Authenticator. Turn it on under Settings > Account Security.
faq.16.question: Is my data safe?
faq.16.answer: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt, JWT sessions are signed, HTML input is cleaned through a strict allowlist, and raw IPs are never stored (country code only). SSL/HTTPS is enforced.
faq.17.question: Can I delete my page?
faq.17.answer: Yes, you can delete your account anytime under Settings > Account. Deletion is permanent and covers all your data: profiles, links, and analytics.
faq.18.question: Does the BeyLink brand show on my profile?
faq.18.answer: On Free and Basic, there's a small BeyLink badge in the bottom corner. On Pro and Pro Plus, you can hide it.
faq.19.question: I have a question. Who can I reach?
faq.19.answer: Email us at destek@beylink.org or use the Help Center > Contact form. Pro and Pro Plus subscribers get priority support.
faq.20.question: Do you have a mobile app?
faq.20.answer: For now, the mobile web experience runs flawlessly on every device. A native mobile app is on our roadmap.
faq.21.question: What makes you different from the competition?
faq.21.answer: Multi-language support, USDT payments, sub-account management, genuine anti-fraud analytics, and SEO infrastructure, all in one package. We set out to fill the details that bigger platforms overlook.

pages.about.story.title: Why we started
pages.about.story.p1: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube all leave room for just one link. But you don't live in a single place: you have accounts, products, a blog, a business card. Every time you send visitors off to “check the link in bio,” you lose half of them along the way.
pages.about.story.p2: BeyLink was born to fix exactly that. Tools like Linktree and Heylink didn't quite meet creators' needs around crypto payments, real anti-fraud analytics, and sub-account management. So we built a better alternative: fast, clean, and measurable.
pages.about.story.p3: We're a small team, and we work close to our users. Every decision is made with them in mind, and every feature starts as a real need before it ever becomes code.

legal.privacy.intro: At BeyLink, we respect your personal data. This policy explains what data we collect from you, why we collect it, how we use it, and what your rights are. If you have questions, email us at destek@beylink.org.
legal.privacy.s1.title: Data Controller
legal.privacy.s1.body: Within the BeyLink Service, the data controller for your personal data is the BeyLink team. Contact: destek@beylink.org.
legal.privacy.s2.title: Data We Collect
legal.privacy.s2.lead: To provide our Service, we collect the following data:
legal.privacy.s2.items.0.label: Account information:
legal.privacy.s2.items.0.text: email, username, and password (irreversibly hashed with bcrypt).
legal.privacy.s2.items.1.label: Profile information:
legal.privacy.s2.items.1.text: name, bio, avatar, and cover (the data you choose to publish on your profile).
legal.privacy.s2.items.2.label: Link and block content:
legal.privacy.s2.items.2.text: the links, social accounts, and cards you add.
legal.privacy.s2.items.3.label: Analytics data:
legal.privacy.s2.items.3.text: visitor count, device type, browser, operating system, and country (the IP address is converted to a country code only;
legal.privacy.s2.items.4.label: Payment information:
legal.privacy.s2.items.4.text: for USDT (TRC-20) payments, the transaction ID (txid), amount, and recipient address. We do not store credit card information.
legal.privacy.s2.items.5.label: Log records:
legal.privacy.s2.items.5.text: for security and audit purposes, such as authentication events and plan changes.
legal.privacy.s3.title: How We Use Your Data
legal.privacy.s3.items.0: To create your account, verify your identity, and keep your session secure.
legal.privacy.s3.items.1: To display, save, and publish your profile and content.
legal.privacy.s3.items.2: To provide the analytics service, showing click and view metrics in your dashboard.
legal.privacy.s3.items.3: To verify payment transactions and manage your balance and purchases.
legal.privacy.s3.items.4: To improve our Service, diagnose errors, and monitor security incidents.
legal.privacy.s3.items.5: To send product updates and informational emails where you have given consent.
legal.privacy.s4.title: Legal Basis
legal.privacy.s4.body: We process your data on the basis of (a) performance of a contract (providing the Service), (b) legitimate interest (security and improvement), (c) your explicit consent (marketing communications), and (d) our legal obligations (invoicing, auditing).
legal.privacy.s5.title: Sharing with Third Parties
legal.privacy.s5.lead: We do not sell your data. Where limited and necessary, we share it with the following service providers:
legal.privacy.s5.items.0.label: Resend
legal.privacy.s5.items.0.text: is used to send transactional emails (registration confirmation, password reset, payment notification).
legal.privacy.s5.items.1.label: TronGrid
legal.privacy.s5.items.1.text: is used to verify USDT payments on the blockchain (sender address and amount only).
legal.privacy.s5.items.2.label: Legal authorities
legal.privacy.s5.items.2.text: receive your data only when legally required to do so.
legal.privacy.s5.outro: Data processing agreements (DPAs) are in place with these providers.
legal.privacy.s6.title: Retention Period
legal.privacy.s6.body: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, your personal data is deleted within 30 days (due to our financial obligations, payment records are kept for the statutory retention period, approximately 10 years).
legal.privacy.s7.title: Security Measures
legal.privacy.s7.body: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. Sessions are signed with JWT, and old sessions are invalidated when your password changes. Two-factor authentication (TOTP) is available. HTML input is sanitized with a strict allowlist. Raw IPs are never stored. Traffic is encrypted over HTTPS.
legal.privacy.s8.title: Your Rights
legal.privacy.s8.items.0: Access your data and request copies of it.
legal.privacy.s8.items.2: Request deletion of your data (right to be forgotten).
legal.privacy.s8.items.3: Object to processing or request that it be restricted.
legal.privacy.s8.items.5: Withdraw consent you have given (for marketing communications).
legal.privacy.s9.title: Cookies
legal.privacy.s9.body.pre: For details on how we use cookies, we have a separate
legal.privacy.s10.title: Policy Changes
legal.privacy.s10.body: We may update this policy from time to time. For significant changes, we will notify you by email. Changes are reflected on this page via the "last updated" date.
legal.privacy.s11.title: Contact
legal.privacy.s11.body: For questions about this policy or to exercise your rights, email us at destek@beylink.org. We respond to requests within 30 days at the latest.
legal.terms.intro: By using the BeyLink Service, you accept the following terms. Please read them carefully. For questions, contact destek@beylink.org.
legal.terms.s1.title: Service Description
legal.terms.s1.body: BeyLink is a link-in-bio SaaS platform where users gather all their social media, product, contact, and content links on a single page. We provide the Service "as is"; it is continuously improved, but we do not guarantee 100% uptime (our target is ~99.5% uptime).
legal.terms.s2.title: Account Creation and Responsibility
legal.terms.s2.items.0: You must be at least 18 years old to register, or register with the consent of your legal guardian.
legal.terms.s2.items.1: You must provide accurate and up-to-date information; using a fake identity or impersonating others is prohibited.
legal.terms.s2.items.2: You are responsible for the security of your account (password, 2FA). Report any suspicious activity to us immediately.
legal.terms.s2.items.3: Your username (profile slug) cannot be changed after registration; choose it carefully.
legal.terms.s3.title: Prohibited Content
legal.terms.s3.lead.pre: The following types of content are
legal.terms.s3.lead.post: on your BeyLink profile, and if detected your account will be suspended or deleted:
legal.terms.s3.items.0: Illegal content (smuggling, fraud, child abuse, terrorist propaganda).
legal.terms.s3.items.2: Impersonation of individuals or organizations, trademark infringement, or fraudulent fake content.
legal.terms.s3.items.3: Links containing malware, phishing, or viruses.
legal.terms.s3.items.4: Adult sexual content (without consent or age verification).
legal.terms.s3.items.5: Spam, automated traffic inflation, fake clicks.
legal.terms.s3.items.6: Intellectual property infringement (unauthorized copyrighted content, trademarks).
legal.terms.s3.outro: To report a violation, contact destek@beylink.org.
legal.terms.s4.title: Ownership of User Content
legal.terms.s4.body: The content you publish on your profile belongs to you. However, so that we can provide the Service, you grant us a limited, worldwide, royalty-free license to use it (to display, store, and cache your content). These rights end if you delete your account.
legal.terms.s5.title: Plans, Payment, and Cancellation
legal.terms.s5.items.0.pre: We offer 4 plans: Free, Basic ($5), Pro ($10), and Pro Plus ($40). See the
legal.terms.s5.items.1: Paid plans are billed monthly. Our payment method is USDT (TRC-20) crypto payment; you purchase plans/packages from your credit balance.
legal.terms.s5.items.2: Plans can only be upgraded. You cannot switch to a lower plan; however, when your upgraded plan expires, your lower plan resumes automatically (remaining days are not lost).
legal.terms.s5.items.3: Crypto transactions confirmed on the blockchain cannot be reversed. We are not responsible for payments made in the wrong amount or to the wrong wallet; however, we will review such cases in good faith.
legal.terms.s5.items.4: The Free plan is always available; to "downgrade" from a paid plan to Free whenever you wish, you simply wait for your current plan’s term to expire.
legal.terms.s6.title: Account Cancellation & Suspension
legal.terms.s6.body: You can delete your account at any time from Settings > Account. Deletion is permanent. We may also suspend or delete accounts that violate these Terms, with prior notice or, in urgent cases, immediately.
legal.terms.s7.title: Limitation of Liability
legal.terms.s7.body: We provide the Service "as is." To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or expected loss of profit. Our liability for direct damages is limited to the amount you paid over the last 12 months.
legal.terms.s8.title: Third-Party Links
legal.terms.s8.body: We are not responsible for external links you add to your profile. Visitors use these links at their own risk.
legal.terms.s9.title: Changes to the Terms
legal.terms.s9.body: We may update these Terms. We will announce significant changes by email or in-app notification. Your continued use of the Service after such changes means you accept the updated Terms.
legal.terms.s11.title: Contact
legal.terms.s11.body: For questions about these Terms, please email destek@beylink.org.
legal.cookies.intro: In short, BeyLink is not a site that stores cookies in the classic sense. Your session and preferences are kept in your browser’s memory (localStorage); we do not send you a separate cookie. There is a single exception, which we explain below.
legal.cookies.s1.title: What We Store, and Where?
legal.cookies.s1.items.0.a: keeps you signed in. It is stored
legal.cookies.s1.items.0.b: , not as a cookie. It is sent manually by the browser on every request and never travels on its own.
legal.cookies.s1.items.1.a: is a randomly generated, non-personal visitor ID (it prevents the same click or view from being counted twice on the same day). Its main copy is kept
legal.cookies.s1.items.1.b: , and the browser also writes it, with the same value, into
legal.cookies.s1.items.2.a: is a functional preference record that remembers your chosen interface language (e.g. English/Russian). It is stored
legal.cookies.s1.items.2.b: , is never sent to the server, and contains no personal data.
legal.cookies.s1.outro: Beyond these, BeyLink’s own site stores nothing: no advertising cookies, no Google Analytics, no cross-site tracking.
legal.cookies.s2.title: Why Does That One Cookie Exist?
legal.cookies.s2.body: When you click a link, our server records the click. But at that moment the server cannot access localStorage; it can only read the cookie the browser sends automatically. That is why beylink_vid is nothing more than a mirror that lets the number in localStorage reach the server. It carries no other data, is never sent to a third-party site, and is never used for advertising.
legal.cookies.s3.title: The Facebook Pixel on Your Profile (if any)
legal.cookies.s3.body: Some users can add a Facebook Pixel to their own public profiles (this is a profile setting; it does not run on BeyLink’s own site, only on that user’s beylink.org/username page). If you visit such a profile, cookies belonging to Meta may activate using that profile owner’s pixel ID. These are controlled by Meta and the profile owner, not by us.
legal.cookies.s4.title: If You Want to Clear Them
legal.cookies.s4.body: Simply clearing your browser’s site data is enough, since it deletes both beylink_token and beylink_vid. As a result you are logged out and will need to sign in again; your visitor counter also restarts from scratch with a new number. There is no cookie on the server side that you need to delete separately.
